key.name: brightness-buckets
key.description: Array of brightness buckets defining how screen brightness responds to ambient light. Each tuple contains: (minimum_lux, maximum_lux, brightness_level). Brightness level is 0.0-1.0 (0-100%). Ranges can overlap to provide hysteresis effect.

key.name: keyboard-backlight-levels
key.description: Array of keyboard backlight levels for each brightness bucket. Each value is the backlight brightness level (0 to hardware max) to apply when in that bucket. 0 means backlight is off for that bucket. The array length must match the number of brightness buckets. Default: [2, 1, 0, 0, 0] means full brightness in darkest bucket, low in second bucket, off for others.

key.name: keyboard-idle-timeout
key.description: Time in seconds of user inactivity before the keyboard backlight is turned off to save power. The backlight will automatically turn back on when user activity is detected in low light conditions.

key.name: fullscreen-brightness-bucket
key.summary: Brightness bucket used during fullscreen video
key.description: Index of the brightness bucket whose brightness is applied while a fullscreen video is playing on the primary monitor. Ambient light adjustments are suspended during that time. -1 disables the feature. Out-of-range values are treated as disabled.

key.name: fullscreen-require-inhibitor
key.summary: Require an idle inhibitor to detect video playback
key.description: When enabled, fullscreen is only treated as video playback if an application also holds a session idle inhibitor, which media players and browsers do while a video is playing. When disabled, any fullscreen window on the primary monitor counts.
